name: Security camera
means: Surveillance footage: a wide lens mounted high in a corner looking down, barrel distortion, blown highlights and crushed blacks from no exposure control, near-monochrome colour, and a burnt-in timestamp.
prose: a still from a fixed surveillance camera mounted high in a corner, wide-angle lens with barrel distortion looking down across the room, harsh overhead lighting with blown highlights and crushed black shadows, desaturated near-monochrome, burnt-in white timestamp text reading "2026-01-14 03:42:17" in the upper corner
negative_add: shallow depth of field, cinematic lighting, colour grading, professional photography, illustration, anime
works_for: video in one respect only: a locked-off camera is the friendliest possible case for LTX, since nothing needs to move but the subject. The degradation is the problem - any compression blocking baked into the keyframe gets smoothed or smeared. Degrade the finished clip, not the keyframe. Inferred.
note: Weak because the defining marks are DEGRADATIONS, and a generator asked for a bad image makes a clean image of a bad thing. Low resolution, compression blocking and interlacing are per-pixel damage - the same class of thing studio/tags/film_grain.json measured as undeliverable from a prompt. The build that actually works: take the camera POSITION, the distortion and the lighting from this prompt at full quality, then downscale, re-encode at a punishing bitrate and re-upscale in post. The one part qwen does better than expected is the timestamp, because it renders literal quoted text well - so give it the exact string you want. Unavailable on the anime checkpoint. | Downgraded to untested: NOTHING in this library was rendered when it was authored, so every strength and engine call is a considered prediction. This project's own standard - written on the Illustrious checkpoint card - is that a recommendation is not a measurement.
verdict: Fisheye, timestamp burn-in, monochrome cast - convincing, but it also drew the camera itself into frame.
verified_by: Looked at, against the no-style control at the same seed with the same subject. studio/_tools/style_examples.py
